name: Sirca Paints India Limited
summary: Sirca Paints India Limited manufactures and sells wood coatings and decorative paints in India and internationally. The company offers wood, metal, glass, polyester, metallic, specialty, protective, polyurethane polish (PU), and nitrocellulose (NC) coatings; wall paints; solid color finishes and wall textures; acrylic PUs and UVs; enamels; thinners, reducers, retarders, paint removers, and interior finishing products; and melamine and economical PU products. It sells its products under the Sirca, Oikos, Wembley, Valentino, Welcome, Unico, San Marco, and Durante Vivan brands.
